pages.title: Defense and response
pages.text: Native sleep blocks incoming damage. The knight has straight and side attacks: sidestep a thrust and create distance from a sweep. Return for a short sequence once the motion finishes, rather than attacking during awakening.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Metal Debris, Somber Key Blade. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
